subject: general
question: How many more Fundamental duty/duties had been added to the Indian Constitution by 86th Amendment Act 2002?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **86th Amendment Act of 2002 added one fundamental duty to the Indian Constitution**
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976 added 10 fundamental duties to the Constitutio**n, and** the 86th Amendment Act of 2002 added the 11th. **
 
• All **11 duties are listed in Article 51A of the Constitution.**
 
• The **11th fundamental duty which was added to this list is**: 
 
 
• To provide opportunities for education to children between 6-14 years of age, and duty as parents to ensure that such opportunities are being awarded to their child
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **same amendment inserted Article 21A **which made the Right to Education a fundamental right for children between 6-14 years.
 
• Th**e Fundamental Duty added by the Constitution (86th Amendment) Act, 2002 is that it is the duty of a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be ward between the age of six and fourteen years**
 
• Fundamental duties are sections of the Constitution of India that prescribe the fundamental obligations of the states to its citizens and the duties.
